<!doctype html>
<html lang="fr">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,viewport-fit=cover">
<title>G10 Adhésion — Version de validation Marie-Josée</title>
<meta name="theme-color" content="#0b4a7a">
<style>
:root{--navy:#0b355a;--blue:#0d6fb8;--sky:#eaf5ff;--green:#16945f;--yellow:#f3c929;--red:#c73d45;--orange:#e79a31;--ink:#142234;--muted:#65778c;--bg:#f4f7fb;--line:#dce5ef;--white:#fff;--shadow:0 16px 45px rgba(13,68,111,.12);--radius:20px}
*{box-sizing:border-box}html,body{margin:0;width:100%;max-width:100%;overflow-x:hidden;font-family:Inter,Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink)}button,input,select,textarea{font:inherit}button{cursor:pointer}a{text-decoration:none;color:inherit}.hidden{display:none!important}.muted{color:var(--muted)}
.screen{min-height:100vh}.landing{position:relative;min-height:100vh;background-image:url('data:image/jpeg;base64,');background-size:cover;background-position:center;overflow:auto}.landing:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,255,255,.95),rgba(255,255,255,.76) 54%,rgba(7,86,163,.22));pointer-events:none}
.container{width:min(1180px,calc(100% - 30px));margin:auto}.topnav{position:relative;z-index:2;padding:20px 0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:18px}.brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:13px;min-width:0}.brand img{width:70px;height:70px;object-fit:contain;background:#fff;border-radius:16px;padding:5px;box-shadow:var(--shadow)}.brandtext strong{display:block;color:var(--navy);font-size:18px}.brandtext span{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.35;display:block;max-width:470px}.nav-actions{display:flex;gap:9px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.btn{border:0;border-radius:13px;padding:11px 16px;font-weight:850;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px}.btn-primary{background:var(--blue);color:#fff}.btn-navy{background:var(--navy);color:#fff}.btn-green{background:var(--green);color:#fff}.btn-yellow{background:var(--yellow);color:#1d2a36}.btn-light{background:#fff;color:var(--navy);border:1px solid var(--line)}.btn-danger{background:#fff0f1;color:#9f2e37;border:1px solid #efcbd0}.btn:disabled{opacity:.55;cursor:not-allowed}
.hero{position:relative;z-index:1;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.2fr .8fr;gap:34px;align-items:center;padding:44px 0 58px}.eyebrow{display:inline-flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;padding:7px 11px;border-radius:999px;background:#e7f3ff;color:#0e5f9e;font-weight:850;font-size:13px}.hero h1{font-size:clamp(42px,6.2vw,76px);line-height:.98;color:var(--navy);margin:17px 0 19px}.hero h1 span{color:var(--blue)}.hero p{font-size:19px;line-height:1.58;color:#44586f;max-width:760px}.hero-actions{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:23px}.mission-tags{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:22px}.tag{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;padding:7px 10px;font-size:12px;font-weight:800;color:#496077}
.hero-card{background:rgba(255,255,255,.94);border:1px solid #d8e5f1;border-radius:26px;padding:26px;box-shadow:0 28px 70px rgba(9,63,104,.16)}.hero-card h2{margin:0 0 8px;color:var(--navy)}.hero-card p{font-size:14px;margin:0 0 18px}.search-box{display:grid;gap:10px}.field{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;min-width:0}.field label{font-size:12px;font-weight:850;color:#526579}.field input,.field select,.field textarea{width:100%;min-width:0;border:1px solid #cad7e4;background:#fff;border-radius:12px;padding:11px 12px;color:var(--ink)}.field textarea{min-height:95px;resize:vertical}.field input:focus,.field select:focus,.field textarea:focus{outline:3px solid rgba(13,111,184,.13);border-color:var(--blue)}
.stats{position:relative;z-index:1;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:13px;padding-bottom:55px}.stat{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;padding:18px;box-shadow:var(--shadow)}.stat span{color:var(--muted);font-size:12px;font-weight:800}.stat strong{display:block;color:var(--navy);font-size:27px;margin-top:5px}.stat small{color:#8392a3;line-height:1.4}
.app{display:grid;grid-template-columns:250px 1fr;min-height:100vh}.sidebar{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#0b355a,#0e5d93);color:#fff;padding:18px 14px;position:sticky;top:0;height:100vh}.side-brand{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;padding:3px 5px 18px}.side-brand img{width:54px;height:54px;object-fit:contain;border-radius:13px;background:#fff;padding:4px}.side-brand strong{font-size:14px;line-height:1.15}.side-brand small{display:block;font-size:10px;opacity:.75;margin-top:4px}.side-nav{display:grid;gap:8px}.navbtn{border:0;background:transparent;color:#ddecf9;border-radius:12px;padding:12px 13px;text-align:left;font-weight:800;display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center}.navbtn.active{background:rgba(255,255,255,.14);color:#fff}.side-foot{position:absolute;bottom:15px;left:14px;right:14px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);padding:12px;border-radius:12px;font-size:11px;line-height:1.4}
.main{padding:22px 25px 45px;min-width:0}.topbar{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:15px;align-items:flex-start;margin-bottom:17px}.topbar h2{margin:0;color:var(--navy);font-size:28px}.topbar p{margin:5px 0 0;color:var(--muted)}.userchip{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:8px 10px;box-shadow:0 6px 20px rgba(13,68,111,.07)}.avatar{width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:12px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--blue),#724fc6);color:#fff;font-weight:900;display:grid;place-items:center}.userchip div{min-width:0}.userchip strong,.userchip small{display:block}.userchip small{color:var(--muted);font-size:11px}
.card{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--radius);box-shadow:var(--shadow)}.panel{padding:18px}.panel+.panel{margin-top:14px}.panel-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;gap:13px;margin-bottom:13px}.panel-head h3{margin:0;color:var(--navy);font-size:18px}.panel-head p{margin:5px 0 0;color:var(--muted);font-size:13px}.badge{display:inline-flex;border-radius:999px;padding:6px 9px;font-size:11px;font-weight:850;white-space:nowrap}.badge-info{background:#e9f3fc;color:#236294}.badge-ok{background:#e8f7ef;color:#1d744e}.badge-warn{background:#fff3db;color:#8d610b}.badge-off{background:#eef1f4;color:#607080}.badge-red{background:#fdebec;color:#a4363d}
.workflow{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(6,1fr);gap:8px}.wstep{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:13px;padding:11px;background:#f9fbfd;display:flex;gap:9px;align-items:flex-start}.wstep b{width:26px;height:26px;min-width:26px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;background:#dfe7ef;color:#51677c;font-size:12px}.wstep strong{font-size:12px;display:block}.wstep small{font-size:10px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.25;display:block;margin-top:3px}.wstep.done{background:#f0fbf5;border-color:#a9dec1}.wstep.done b{background:var(--green);color:#fff}.wstep.active{background:#f0f7fd;border-color:#85b7e1}.wstep.active b{background:var(--blue);color:#fff}
.grid2{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px}.grid3{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:12px}.grid4{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:12px}.form-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:12px}.full{grid-column:1/-1}.sep{height:1px;background:var(--line);margin:15px 0}.section-title{font-weight:900;color:var(--navy);margin:4px 0 11px}.notice{padding:13px 14px;border-radius:12px;background:#fff8e7;border:1px solid #f1d79b;color:#805b0d;font-size:13px;line-height:1.5}.info-box{padding:13px 14px;border-radius:12px;background:#edf6fd;border:1px solid #cde2f3;color:#225c89;font-size:13px;line-height:1.5}.success-box{padding:13px 14px;border-radius:12px;background:#edf9f3;border:1px solid #c5ead7;color:#1d6f4d;font-size:13px;line-height:1.5}
.summary{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:11px}.mini{padding:15px}.mini span{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:800}.mini strong{display:block;font-size:22px;color:var(--navy);margin-top:5px}.action-row{display:flex;gap:9px;justify-content:flex-end;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:15px}.signature-card{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr;gap:10px;border:1px solid var(--line);padding:13px;border-radius:13px;background:#fafcfe}.signature-card input{margin-top:4px}.signature-preview{font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:34px;font-style:italic;color:#123d69;padding:10px 0}
.payment-options{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px}.payment-option{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:14px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr;gap:9px;align-items:start}.payment-option:has(input:checked){border-color:#6aa7d8;background:#f2f8fd}.payment-option strong{display:block;color:var(--navy)}.payment-option small{display:block;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.4;margin-top:3px}
.table-wrap{overflow:auto;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px}.table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;min-width:940px}.table th,.table td{padding:10px;border-bottom:1px solid #e8edf3;text-align:left;font-size:12px;vertical-align:top}.table th{background:#f8fafc;color:#5f7185;position:sticky;top:0}.table tr:hover td{background:#fbfdff}.toolbar{display:flex;gap:9px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:12px}.toolbar input,.toolbar select{max-width:250px}.kpis{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);gap:11px;margin-bottom:14px}.kpi{padding:16px}.kpi span{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:800}.kpi strong{display:block;font-size:25px;color:var(--navy);margin-top:5px}.tabs{display:flex;gap:7px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:13px}.tab{border:1px solid var(--line);background:#fff;color:#557086;border-radius:999px;padding:8px 11px;font-weight:800;font-size:12px}.tab.active{background:var(--navy);border-color:var(--navy);color:#fff}
.doc-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:12px}.doc{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:15px;background:#fff}.doc .icon{width:44px;height:50px;border-radius:10px;display:grid;place-items:center;background:#d63d45;color:#fff;font-size:11px;font-weight:900;margin-bottom:10px}.doc h4{margin:0 0 5px;color:var(--navy)}.doc p{margin:0 0 11px;color:var(--muted);font-size:12px;line-height:1.4}
.modal{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(9,25,42,.64);z-index:5000;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:14px}.modal.open{display:flex}.modal-card{width:min(980px,100%);max-height:94dvh;overflow:auto;background:#fff;border-radius:20px;padding:20px;box-shadow:0 28px 80px rgba(0,0,0,.32)}.modal-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;align-items:flex-start;margin-bottom:13px}.modal-head h3{margin:0;color:var(--navy)}.close{border:0;width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:10px;background:#edf1f5;font-size:19px}.pdf-frame{width:100%;height:74dvh;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px}
.form-sheet{background:#fff;border:1px solid #cfdbe7;border-radius:12px;padding:26px;color:#17233a}.sheet-head{text-align:center;border-bottom:3px solid var(--blue);padding-bottom:13px;margin-bottom:18px}.sheet-head img{height:76px;object-fit:contain}.sheet-head h2{margin:7px 0 3px;color:var(--navy);font-size:22px}.sheet-head strong{color:var(--blue)}.sheet-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:10px}.sheet-field{border:1px solid #dfe6ee;border-radius:9px;padding:8px 9px;min-height:51px}.sheet-field small{display:block;color:#718096;font-size:9px;font-weight:850;text-transform:uppercase}.sheet-field b{display:block;margin-top:4px;font-size:13px}.sheet-full{grid-column:1/-1}.agreement{margin:14px 0;padding:12px;border-radius:10px;background:#f7fafc;border:1px solid #dfe7ef;font-size:12px;line-height:1.5}.signature-line{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:10px;margin-top:12px}.sigbox{border:1px solid #dfe6ee;border-radius:9px;padding:10px;min-height:70px}.sigbox .sig{font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:28px;font-style:italic;color:#123d69;margin-top:5px}
@media print{body>*{display:none!important}#smartFormModal{display:block!important;position:static!important;background:#fff!important;padding:0!important}#smartFormModal .modal-card{box-shadow:none!important;max-height:none!important;width:100%!important;padding:0!important}#smartFormModal .modal-head,#smartFormModal .action-row{display:none!important}.form-sheet{border:0!important;border-radius:0!important}}
@media(max-width:1050px){.workflow{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}.kpis{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}.doc-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.hero{grid-template-columns:1fr}.stats{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}.form-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}
@media(max-width:760px){.brandtext span{display:none}.brand img{width:55px;height:55px}.topnav{align-items:flex-start}.hero{padding-top:22px}.hero h1{font-size:44px}.hero p{font-size:16px}.stats{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.app{display:block}.sidebar{display:none}.main{padding:14px 12px 35px}.topbar{display:block}.userchip{margin-top:10px}.workflow{grid-template-columns:1fr}.form-grid,.grid2,.grid3,.grid4,.summary,.kpis,.doc-grid,.payment-options,.sheet-grid,.signature-line{grid-template-columns:1fr}.full,.sheet-full{grid-column:auto}.panel{padding:14px}.toolbar>*{max-width:none!important;width:100%}.action-row .btn{width:100%}.modal{padding:6px}.modal-card{padding:13px;border-radius:13px}.pdf-frame{height:80dvh}.form-sheet{padding:15px}.nav-actions .btn-light{display:none}}

/* V3 — retour à la présentation V1 BIS, avec les fonctionnalités de campagne V2 */
.landing-shell{position:relative;z-index:2;display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.25fr) minmax(360px,.75fr);gap:34px;align-items:center;min-height:100vh;padding:34px 0}
.landing-left{max-width:800px;color:#0b3970}
.landing-main-logo{width:min(430px,82vw);height:auto;max-height:155px;object-fit:contain;object-position:left center;display:block;margin-bottom:8px;filter:drop-shadow(0 4px 16px rgba(255,255,255,.6))}
.landing-name{font-size:18px;font-weight:850;line-height:1.35;max-width:760px}
.landing-motto{font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.07em;margin:11px 0 36px;color:#0b5d9a;text-transform:uppercase}
.landing-left h1{font-size:clamp(40px,5.6vw,74px);line-height:1.02;margin:0 0 20px;color:#103d6b}
.landing-left h1 span{color:#0876c9}
.landing-left>p{max-width:730px;font-size:19px;font-weight:650;line-height:1.55;color:#23364a}
.landing-actions{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:22px 0 0}
.landing-stats-v3{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:11px;margin-top:28px;max-width:780px}
.landing-stat-v3{border:1px solid #9fc5e8;background:rgba(255,255,255,.93);border-radius:20px;padding:16px 10px;box-shadow:0 8px 22px #1233;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;text-align:center;color:#0b3970}
.landing-stat-v3 strong{font-size:24px}
.landing-stat-v3 span{font-size:12px;font-weight:800;margin-top:5px;line-height:1.25}
.candidate-card-v3{width:100%;max-width:560px;justify-self:end;background:rgba(255,255,255,.97);border:1px solid #d4e3ef;border-radius:24px;padding:27px;box-shadow:0 30px 80px rgba(0,0,0,.28)}
.candidate-card-v3 .candidate-icon{width:72px;height:72px;border-radius:50%;background:#0876c9;color:#fff;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:34px;margin:0 auto 10px}
.candidate-card-v3 h2{text-align:center;font-size:31px;color:var(--navy);margin:5px 0 7px}
.candidate-card-v3>p{text-align:center;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.5;margin:0 0 18px}
.candidate-note{font-size:11px;color:#66798c;line-height:1.45;margin-top:12px}
.motto-chip{display:inline-flex;padding:7px 11px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.88);border:1px solid #b9d5ea;color:#0b5d9a;font-weight:900;font-size:12px;margin-bottom:12px}
.payment-highlight{border:1px solid #f0d28b;background:#fff8df;border-radius:14px;padding:14px;line-height:1.5;margin-top:12px}
.payment-highlight strong{color:#0b355a}
.whatsapp-btn{background:#1b9c5a;color:#fff}
.doc .icon.charte{background:#188956}.doc .icon.statuts{background:#0d6fb8}.doc .icon.ri{background:#7a5ab5}
@media(max-width:980px){.landing-shell{grid-template-columns:1fr;padding:24px 0 40px}.candidate-card-v3{justify-self:stretch;max-width:none}.landing-stats-v3{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}
@media(max-width:760px){.landing{background-position:center top}.landing:before{background:rgba(255,255,255,.78)}.landing-shell{padding:18px 0 30px}.landing-main-logo{width:280px;max-height:120px}.landing-name{font-size:14px}.landing-motto{font-size:11px;margin-bottom:24px}.landing-left h1{font-size:43px}.landing-left>p{font-size:16px}.landing-stats-v3{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.landing-stat-v3{padding:13px 7px}.candidate-card-v3{padding:21px 17px}.candidate-card-v3 h2{font-size:27px}}

/* V4 — règles fermes de l'accueil validé */
.landing-actions .btn{min-width:185px}
.home-feature-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:12px}
.home-feature{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:15px;padding:14px;background:#f9fbfd}
.home-feature h4{margin:0 0 5px;color:var(--navy)}
.home-feature p{margin:0;color:var(--muted);font-size:13px;line-height:1.5}
.video-placeholder{aspect-ratio:16/9;border-radius:16px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#0b355a,#0d6fb8);display:grid;place-items:center;color:white;text-align:center;padding:20px}
.video-placeholder b{font-size:22px}
@media(max-width:760px){.home-feature-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.landing-actions .btn{width:100%}}

/* V4.1 — panneau d'adhésion latéral validé */
#joinModal{
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:flex-end;
  padding:24px 4vw;
  background:rgba(8,35,58,.18);
  backdrop-filter:none;
}
#joinModal .modal-card{
  width:min(570px,94vw);
  max-height:calc(100dvh - 48px);
  margin-left:auto;
  margin-right:0;
  padding:27px 28px 30px;
  border-radius:28px;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.985);
  box-shadow:0 30px 90px rgba(7,45,76,.28);
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.9);
  overflow:auto;
}
#joinModal .modal-head{
  margin-bottom:8px;
  align-items:flex-start;
}
#joinModal .modal-head h3{
  font-size:31px;
  text-align:center;
  width:100%;
  margin-top:6px;
}
#joinModal .modal-head p{
  text-align:center;
  margin:6px 0 12px;
}
#joinModal .close{
  position:absolute;
  top:18px;
  right:18px;
  z-index:2;
}
#joinModal .candidate-card-v3{
  width:100%;
  max-width:none!important;
  box-shadow:none!important;
  border:0!important;
  padding:0!important;
  background:transparent!important;
}
#joinModal .candidate-card-v3 .candidate-icon{
  width:76px;
  height:76px;
  font-size:34px;
  margin-top:2px;
}
#joinModal .candidate-card-v3 h2{
  font-size:30px;
}
#joinModal .btn{
  min-height:46px;
}
@media(max-width:760px){
  #joinModal{
    justify-content:center;
    align-items:center;
    padding:10px;
    background:rgba(8,35,58,.28);
  }
  #joinModal .modal-card{
    width:100%;
    max-height:94dvh;
    border-radius:22px;
    padding:22px 18px 24px;
  }
  #joinModal .modal-head h3{font-size:25px}
}


/* =========================================================
   V5 — ACCUEIL VALIDÉ
   Règle ferme : le fond mer original ne doit plus changer.
   Aucun flou du fond lors de l'utilisation de Mon adhésion.
   ========================================================= */
.final-home{
  min-height:100vh;
  display:grid!important;
  grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(340px,430px);
  gap:40px!important;
  align-items:center!important;
  padding:28px 0 32px;
}
.final-left{
  max-width:760px;
  padding-left:0!important;
  transform:translateX(-8px);
}
.final-left .landing-main-logo{
  width:min(410px,62vw)!important;
  max-height:128px;
  object-fit:contain;
  object-position:left center;
  margin-bottom:7px;
}
.final-left .landing-motto{
  margin:0 0 20px!important;
  font-size:14px!important;
  letter-spacing:.01em!important;
  font-weight:900!important;
  color:#123c68!important;
  text-transform:uppercase;
}
.landing-copy{
  width:min(720px,100%);
  padding:16px 20px 14px;
  border-radius:22px;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,255,255,.50),rgba(255,255,255,.24) 72%,rgba(255,255,255,.05));
}
.landing-copy h1{
  margin:0 0 12px!important;
  font-size:clamp(44px,5vw,68px)!important;
  line-height:.98!important;
  color:#113f72!important;
  letter-spacing:-.035em;
}
.landing-copy h1 span{color:#117ed4!important}
.landing-copy p{
  max-width:690px!important;
  margin:0!important;
  font-size:18px!important;
  line-height:1.48!important;
  color:#142b48!important;
  font-weight:650!important;
}
.final-actions{
  width:min(700px,100%);
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;
  gap:12px;
  margin-top:18px;
}
.home-pill{
  min-height:62px;
  border:1px solid rgba(31,91,143,.20);
  border-radius:28px;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.78);
  color:#0f3d6c;
  box-shadow:0 10px 26px rgba(15,61,108,.11);
  padding:9px 18px;
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:44px 1fr 24px;
  align-items:center;
  gap:10px;
  text-align:left;
  font-weight:900;
  font-size:17px;
}
.home-pill.yellow{background:rgba(255,205,27,.87)}
.home-pill.wide{
  grid-column:1/-1;
  width:68%;
  justify-self:center;
  grid-template-columns:44px 1fr 24px;
}
.home-icon{
  width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:50%;
  display:grid;place-items:center;
  background:#087be2;color:white;
  font-size:15px;letter-spacing:-2px;
}
.home-pill.yellow .home-icon{background:#0d4b8b}
.home-pill b{font-size:23px}
.final-stats{
  width:min(700px,100%);
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);
  gap:10px;
  margin-top:22px;
}
.final-stat{
  min-height:92px;
  border:1px solid rgba(31,91,143,.18);
  border-radius:18px;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.72);
  box-shadow:0 9px 22px rgba(15,61,108,.10);
  color:#113f72;
  padding:11px 10px;
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:34px 1fr;
  grid-template-areas:"ico number" "ico label";
  text-align:left;
  align-items:center;
  column-gap:8px;
}
.final-stat .stat-ico{grid-area:ico;font-weight:1000;font-size:18px}
.final-stat strong{grid-area:number;font-size:25px;line-height:1;font-weight:1000}
.final-stat small{grid-area:label;font-size:11px;line-height:1.22;font-weight:850}
.stat-ico.blue{color:#087be2}.stat-ico.green{color:#18a867}.stat-ico.gold{color:#f1b800}.stat-ico.calendar{color:#087be2}

.home-login-card{
  width:100%;
  align-self:center;
  border-radius:28px;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.84);
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.90);
  box-shadow:0 24px 60px rgba(12,48,82,.18);
  padding:28px 30px 26px;
}
.home-login-avatar{
  width:78px;height:78px;border-radius:50%;
  margin:0 auto 10px;
  display:grid;place-items:center;
  background:#087be2;color:white;
  font-size:32px;
}
.home-login-card h2{
  margin:0 0 22px;
  text-align:center;
  color:#123c68;
  font-size:32px;
}
.home-login-card .field{margin-bottom:12px}
.home-login-card .field label{font-weight:900;color:#123c68}
.home-login-card input{
  background:rgba(244,249,255,.78)!important;
  border:1px solid rgba(38,105,162,.20)!important;
  min-height:52px;
  font-size:16px;
}
.password-wrap{position:relative}
.password-wrap input{padding-right:48px!important}
.eye-btn{
  position:absolute;right:8px;top:7px;
  width:38px;height:38px;border:0;background:transparent;color:#0d4b8b;
  font-size:18px;
}
.home-login-btn{width:100%;min-height:50px;margin-top:8px;font-size:17px}
.home-forgot{
  display:block;margin:15px auto 0;border:0;background:transparent;
  color:#087be2;font-weight:900;font-size:14px;
}
.home-login-message{
  margin-top:12px;min-height:18px;text-align:center;
  font-size:12px;font-weight:800;color:#0d4b8b;
}
.landing::after{display:none!important}
#joinModal{display:none!important}

/* Les fenêtres informatives n'altèrent pas l'image de fond. */
.modal{background:rgba(8,35,58,.14)!important}
.modal.open{backdrop-filter:none!important;-webkit-backdrop-filter:none!important}

@media(max-width:980px){
  .final-home{grid-template-columns:1fr 360px;gap:20px}
  .landing-copy h1{font-size:clamp(38px,5vw,56px)!important}
  .landing-copy p{font-size:16px!important}
}
@media(max-width:820px){
  .final-home{grid-template-columns:1fr;align-items:start!important;padding:18px 0 28px}
  .final-left{transform:none;max-width:none}
  .final-left .landing-main-logo{width:min(500px,92vw)!important}
  .landing-copy{padding:13px 14px}
  .landing-copy h1{font-size:clamp(38px,10vw,56px)!important}
  .final-actions{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
  .home-pill.wide{width:100%}
  .final-stats{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
  .home-login-card{width:100%;max-width:560px;margin:10px auto 0}
}
@media(max-width:520px){
  .container{width:min(100% - 18px,1180px)!important}
  .final-left .landing-main-logo{width:94vw!important}
  .final-left .landing-motto{font-size:11px!important;margin-bottom:12px!important}
  .landing-copy h1{font-size:39px!important}
  .landing-copy p{font-size:15px!important}
  .final-actions{gap:9px}
  .home-pill{min-height:54px;border-radius:20px;padding:7px 10px;font-size:14px;grid-template-columns:34px 1fr 18px}
  .home-icon{width:32px;height:32px;font-size:12px}
  .home-pill b{font-size:18px}
  .final-stats{gap:8px;margin-top:15px}
  .final-stat{min-height:76px;border-radius:15px;padding:8px 7px;grid-template-columns:26px 1fr}
  .final-stat strong{font-size:21px}.final-stat small{font-size:10px}.final-stat .stat-ico{font-size:14px}
  .home-login-card{padding:22px 18px 20px;border-radius:22px}
  .home-login-card h2{font-size:27px}
}


/* V5.1 — accès Direction discret pour la démonstration */
.home-direction-link{
  display:block;
  margin:10px auto 0;
  border:0;
  background:transparent;
  color:#5f7186;
  font-size:12px;
  font-weight:850;
  text-decoration:underline;
  text-underline-offset:3px;
}
.home-direction-link:hover{color:#123c68}


/* V5.2 - adhésion validée + cotisations */
.membership-paid-box{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:54px 1fr auto;
  align-items:center;
  gap:14px;
  padding:16px;
  border:1px solid #a9dec1;
  border-radius:16px;
  background:#effaf4;
  color:#176b46;
}
.membership-paid-box.hidden{display:none!important}
.paid-check{
  width:48px;height:48px;border-radius:50%;
  background:var(--green);color:#fff;
  display:grid;place-items:center;
  font-size:27px;font-weight:1000;
}
.membership-paid-box p{margin:4px 0 0;color:#456b59;font-size:13px}
.member-paid-actions{display:flex;gap:9px;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:flex-end}
.member-paid-actions .btn{white-space:nowrap}
.thanks-modal-card{width:min(760px,94vw)!important;padding:0!important;overflow:hidden}
.thanks-hero{padding:28px 30px 22px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#eef9f4,#edf6ff);text-align:center;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.thanks-check{width:72px;height:72px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--green);color:#fff;display:grid;place-items:center;margin:0 auto 14px;font-size:36px;font-weight:1000;box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(22,148,95,.22)}
.thanks-hero h3{font-size:30px;margin:0;color:var(--navy)}
.thanks-hero p{margin:9px auto 0;max-width:610px;color:#50657b;line-height:1.55}
.thanks-body{padding:22px 28px 28px}
.thanks-message{border-left:4px solid var(--yellow);background:#fff9e8;border-radius:10px;padding:14px 16px;line-height:1.55;margin-bottom:16px}
.thanks-video{width:100%;border-radius:16px;background:#071d2d;display:block;max-height:58vh}
.thanks-actions{display:flex;gap:10px;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:16px}
@media(max-width:720px){.member-paid-actions{grid-column:1/-1;justify-content:stretch}.member-paid-actions .btn{flex:1 1 100%}.thanks-hero{padding:24px 18px 18px}.thanks-body{padding:18px}.thanks-hero h3{font-size:25px}}
.contribution-plan-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px;margin-top:14px}
@media(max-width:720px){
  .membership-paid-box{grid-template-columns:48px 1fr}
  .membership-paid-box .btn{grid-column:1/-1}
  .contribution-plan-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
}


/* V5.3 — choix de signature, situation membre et historique Direction */
.form-mode-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px}
.form-mode-card{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:15px;background:#fff;padding:14px;display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:center;text-align:left;color:var(--navy);font-weight:800}
.form-mode-card.active{border-color:#5aa3db;background:#eef7fd;box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(13,111,184,.08)}
.form-mode-icon{width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:12px;display:grid;place-items:center;background:var(--blue);color:#fff;font-weight:1000;font-size:12px;flex:0 0 44px}
.form-mode-card small{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-weight:600;margin-top:4px;line-height:1.35}
.situation-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:12px}
.situation-item{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;background:#f8fbfd;padding:13px}
.situation-item span{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:11px;font-weight:850;text-transform:uppercase}
.situation-item strong{display:block;color:var(--navy);font-size:17px;margin-top:5px}
.history-actions{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.btn-danger{background:#fff0f0;color:#a32929;border:1px solid #efb1b1}
@media(max-width:720px){.form-mode-grid,.situation-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}


.demo-reset-card{border:1px solid #efd59a;background:#fffdf7}
.demo-reset-card .notice.warn{background:#fff7df;border-color:#efd59a;color:#725514}

/* V6.2 — retours relecteur : navigation, footer, clarté workflow */
@media(min-width:761px){.app>.sidebar{position:sticky;top:0;height:100vh;align-self:start;overflow-y:auto}}
.g10-footer{margin-top:28px;padding:18px 14px;border-top:1px solid #dce5ef;text-align:center;color:#6a7a8c;font-size:12px;line-height:1.45}
.mobile-member-nav{display:none}
@media(max-width:760px){
  .main{padding-bottom:92px!important}
  .mobile-member-nav{position:fixed;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);left:10px;right:10px;bottom:max(10px,env(safe-area-inset-bottom));z-index:4200;background:#fff;border:1px solid #dce5ef;border-radius:18px;box-shadow:0 12px 35px rgba(10,35,60,.18);overflow:hidden}
  .mobile-member-nav button{border:0;background:#fff;padding:10px 4px 9px;color:#24425f;font-weight:800;font-size:11px;line-height:1.2}
  .mobile-member-nav button span{display:block;font-size:18px;margin-bottom:3px}
}

/* =========================================================
   V6.3 — ASTUCE PWA VALIDÉE
   ========================================================= */
.landing-copy h1{font-size:clamp(40px,4.65vw,62px)!important}
.home-login-card{padding:24px 26px 22px!important}
.home-login-avatar{width:72px!important;height:72px!important}
.home-login-card h2{font-size:29px!important;margin-bottom:18px!important}
.home-login-card input{min-height:49px!important}
.home-login-btn{min-height:47px!important}
.home-install-tip{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:7px;margin:12px auto 0;padding:7px 13px;border:1px solid #b9d5ea;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.92);color:#0876c9;font-weight:900;font-size:13px;box-shadow:0 5px 14px rgba(13,68,111,.08)}
.home-install-tip:hover{background:#f2f8fd}
.install-help-overlay{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:10000;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:18px;background:rgba(8,35,58,.76);backdrop-filter:blur(7px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(7px)}
.install-help-overlay.open{display:flex}
.install-help-card{position:relative;width:min(560px,100%);max-height:92dvh;overflow:auto;background:#fff;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.9);border-radius:22px;padding:24px;box-shadow:0 30px 90px rgba(0,0,0,.34);color:#142234}
.install-help-card h3{margin:0 42px 8px 0;color:#0b355a;font-size:22px}

.install-help-list{display:grid;gap:10px}
.install-help-item{display:grid;grid-template-columns:44px 1fr;gap:12px;align-items:start;padding:13px;border:1px solid #dce5ef;border-radius:14px;background:#fbfdff}
.install-help-ico{width:42px;height:42px;display:grid;place-items:center;border-radius:11px;background:#edf6fd;color:#0b4a7a;font-size:24px}

  .install-help-card h3{font-size:19px}

/* V6.5 PREVIEW — contenus institutionnels, réalisations et vidéos */
.g10-content-modal{width:min(940px,94vw);max-height:90vh;overflow:auto}
.about-intro,.about-panel{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;background:#f9fbfd;padding:16px 18px}
.about-intro{margin-bottom:14px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#f4faff,#fff)}
.about-intro h4,.about-panel h4,.achievement-card h4,.g10-video-card h4{margin:0 0 7px;color:var(--navy)}
.about-intro p,.about-panel p,.achievement-card p,.g10-video-card p{margin:0 0 8px;color:#52677d;line-height:1.58}
.about-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.1fr .9fr;gap:14px;margin-bottom:14px}
.value-chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px}
.value-chips span{padding:8px 11px;border-radius:999px;background:#eaf5ff;color:#0b4a7a;font-weight:700;font-size:13px;border:1px solid #cfe6f8}
.credo-panel{display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#0b4a7a,#0d6fb8);color:white}
.credo-panel h4{color:white}.credo-panel blockquote{margin:4px 0 0;font-size:21px;font-weight:800;line-height:1.35;color:white}
.commitments{margin-bottom:14px}.commitment-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:10px}.commitment-grid>div{background:white;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:13px;padding:12px}.commitment-grid p{font-size:13px;margin-top:5px}.join-panel{background:#fff9e5;border-color:#f0d47b}
.achievement-list{display:grid;gap:12px}.achievement-card{display:grid;grid-template-columns:58px 1fr;gap:14px;padding:15px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;background:#f9fbfd}.achievement-num{display:grid;place-items:center;width:50px;height:50px;border-radius:15px;background:#0d6fb8;color:white;font-weight:900;font-size:18px}.achievement-kpis{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:8px;margin:12px 0}.achievement-kpis span{background:white;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:10px;text-align:center}.achievement-kpis b{display:block;color:#0b4a7a;font-size:16px}.achievement-kpis small{display:block;color:#65778c;margin-top:3px;font-size:10px}.achievement-sub{font-size:13px!important;margin-top:6px!important}
.video-stack{display:grid;gap:16px}.g10-video-card{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;background:#f9fbfd;padding:14px}.video-card-head{display:flex;gap:11px;align-items:flex-start;margin-bottom:10px}.video-badge{display:grid;place-items:center;min-width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:11px;background:#0d6fb8;color:#fff;font-weight:900}.g10-video-card video{width:100%;border-radius:14px;background:#0b355a;max-height:520px}
.video-modal-actions{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap}.video-modal-actions .btn{padding:9px 12px}.video-mini-bar{position:fixed;right:18px;bottom:18px;z-index:7000;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;max-width:min(520px,calc(100vw - 28px));padding:12px 14px;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;box-shadow:0 18px 50px rgba(5,40,70,.25)}.video-mini-bar.hidden{display:none!important}.video-mini-copy{min-width:0;flex:1}.video-mini-copy small{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:11px;font-weight:800;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.04em}.video-mini-copy b{display:block;color:var(--navy);white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}.video-mini-actions{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center}.video-mini-actions .btn{padding:9px 11px}.video-mini-close{border:0;background:#eef3f7;border-radius:10px;width:34px;height:34px;font-size:18px;font-weight:900;color:var(--navy)}
@media(max-width:760px){.video-mini-bar{left:10px;right:10px;bottom:10px}.video-mini-copy b{white-space:normal}.video-modal-actions .btn{padding:8px 10px;font-size:12px}}
@media(max-width:760px){.about-grid,.commitment-grid,.achievement-kpis{grid-template-columns:1fr}.achievement-card{grid-template-columns:44px 1fr}.achievement-num{width:40px;height:40px}.g10-content-modal{width:96vw}}

/* Accordéons de l'espace adhérent — V6.14 */
.member-accordion-head{
  cursor:pointer;
  user-select:none;
  border-radius:12px;
  padding:7px 9px;
  margin:-7px -9px 0;
  transition:background .16s ease;
}
.member-accordion-head:hover{background:#f5f9fc}
.member-accordion-head:focus{outline:3px solid rgba(14,112,184,.18);outline-offset:2px}
.member-accordion-side{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px}
.member-accordion-chevron{
  width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:50%;
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  border:1px solid var(--line);background:#fff;color:var(--navy);
  font-size:18px;font-weight:900;line-height:1;
  transition:transform .18s ease,background .18s ease;
}
.member-accordion.open .member-accordion-chevron{transform:rotate(180deg);background:#eef6fc}
.member-accordion-body{padding-top:14px}
.member-accordion-body[hidden]{display:none!important}
.member-accordion.member-accordion-collapsed{padding-bottom:12px}
.member-accordion.member-accordion-collapsed .member-accordion-head{margin-bottom:0}

<!-- PREVIEW V6.8 — gestion vidéo robuste : fermer/réduire, libération mémoire, verrou anti-réouverture -->
<!-- G10-ADHESION V6.4 COTISATION ANNUELLE CORRIGEE — WhatsApp inchangé -->
<div id="landing" class="screen landing">
  <div class="container">
    <div class="landing-shell final-home">
      <section class="landing-left final-left">
        <img class="landing-main-logo" src="data:image/png;base64,
